title: Stop/wait/release improves original requests without losing a completion.
summary: Connector qualification supported: all 23 baseline requests reproduce; full completions rise 1/23 to 8/23. Two left-bend requests finish in eight attempts. Synthetic goals improve separately from 5/21 to 13/21; all queried states replay.
boundary: Exposed-request qualification, not a new integrated result. Integrated credit remains 3/4; source comparison stays closed. No new driving, actual-history recovery, measured response delay or competitor superiority.
next: Preregister one all-four integrated trial with unchanged budgets and allocation, reporting gains and losses against Iter189 and Iter183.
